acceptance_invariants: Original bytes/hash and every block text/text_hash/order remain unchanged.
All table data, row/column coordinates and spans remain unchanged.
Repeated navigation may receive layout_role; source text and IDs must remain.
Only independently identified body titles become Item nodes; source TOC is not a second body outline.
Unresolved or conflicting titles remain explicit; no invented Item numbers or company-specific production defaults.
